title.narrative: Apoyo al Programa de Reformas del Sector Transporte y Logstica de Panam II
Support For Panama's Transport and Logistics Sector Reform Program II

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a la mejora del desempeo logstico de Panam a travs de la reduccin de restricciones normativas e institucionales que limitan el desempeo del pas especialmente en los mbitos de: (i) Servicios Logsticos de Valor Agregado (SLVA); (ii) logstica de apoyo al sector agrcola; y (iii) logstica de apoyo al comercio regional. Los objetivos especficos del programa son: (i) fortalecimiento del marco legal y regulatorio; (ii) consolidacin del marco institucional de logstica y transporte; y (iii) fortalecimiento del sistema de planificacin multisectorial y de facilitacin comercial, que contribuirn a una mejor planificacin de la inversin en el sector de logstica y transporte, la ampliacin del rea logstica utilizada, a la reduccin del tiempo del despacho de mercancas y a la provisin de recursos humanos en el rea de logstica. La presente operacin es la segunda de tres consecutivas de un solo tramo cada una, vinculadas tcnicamente entre s, pero financiadas en forma independiente bajo la modalidad de prstamo programtico en apoyo de reformas de poltica.

The objective of the program is to help improve Panama's logistics performance by reducing regulatory and institutional restrictions that limit the country's performance, primarily in the following areas: (i) value-added logistics services; (ii) logistics that support the agriculture sector; and (iii) logistics that support regional trade. The program's specific objectives are to: (i) strengthen the legal and regulatory framework; (ii) consolidate the institutional framework for transport and logistics; and (iii) strengthen the multisector planning and trade facilitation system, which will help to improve investment planning in the transport and logistics sector, expand the surface area devoted to logistics in use, reduce customs clearance time for freight, and provide human resources for the logistics area. This operation is the second loan in a series of three consecutive single-tranche operations, technically related to one another but independently financed as programmatic policy-based loans.
Commitment in 2016-05-11
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2016
